Dear Spotable Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Growth Marketer position at Spotable, as advertised. My background as a Digital Marketer, focused on SEO, GEO, and AI-powered search optimization, aligns well with your mission to drive measurable business growth for contractors.

In my previous roles, I have consistently applied a data-driven approach to optimize web presence, improve search visibility, and enhance content performance, using tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, and Semrush. I am particularly adept at leveraging AI tools and prompt engineering for content and audits, which I believe would be valuable in exploring new acquisition channels, including AI-assisted advertising. My experience includes running iterative SEO/GEO audits and implementing structured data, directly contributing to improved search health scores.

I am eager to bring my blend of technical and marketing skills, coupled with my experience in Google Ads, to Spotable's acquisition and activation funnel, contributing to your expansion into new markets.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Spotable Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Growth Marketer position at Spotable. Your commitment to leveraging AI to empower roofing and façade contractors, alongside the emphasis on measurable growth and experimentation, deeply resonates with my professional approach and skills.

My career as a Digital Marketer has been centered on transforming digital presence into tangible growth, operating at the intersection of SEO, content, and web optimization, with a significant focus on AI-powered search. At Knowledge Experts, I was instrumental in building and optimizing client websites, notably for mirook.com, where I implemented JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file. Through iterative technical SEO and GEO audits, I measurably raised the site's search-health score, directly aligning with your need to improve Spotable's GEO visibility and presence in AI-driven search and discovery. This hands-on experience in optimizing for search visibility, coupled with my daily use of LLMs like Claude and ChatGPT for research and content, positions me to explore and test emerging acquisition channels.

As a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I managed on-page SEO, keyword research, and content for client websites, meticulously tracking results using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs. This robust analytical background enables me to monitor signup and activation metrics, analyze campaign performance, and translate insights into concrete actions, as required for this role. My Google Ads Search Certification and experience with Google Ads further bolster my ability to manage and optimize key advertising platforms. My strong foundation in performance marketing principles, data analysis, and A/B testing makes me confident in quickly adapting to and mastering new channels.

I am particularly excited by the prospect of building a scalable growth engine and owning the journey from ad to activation within a dynamic AI company. My experience in creating and optimizing websites from structure to content, coupled with my problem-solving mindset and comfort working independently, would allow me to set up and run growth experiments effectively. I am eager to apply my analytical, entrepreneurial spirit to help Spotable expand into new markets and achieve its ambitious growth objectives.

Thank you for considering my application. I am available for an interview at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- Expertise in SEO, GEO, and AI-powered search visibility, including daily use of LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude) for content and audits, and implementing llms.txt for AI search optimization.
- Proven ability to drive measurable organic growth through iterative technical SEO/GEO audits and structured data implementation, significantly raising search-health scores for client websites.
- Strong analytical skills to monitor and optimize campaign performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, and experience with Google Ads.
- Hands-on experience in website content management and optimization, including building and updating client sites in WordPress, focused on conversion and user acquisition.
- Fluent in English with B1 writing proficiency in Dutch, capable of crafting and testing marketing copy for diverse audiences.
